recon_esperado.descricao: o ingest ainda nao deduplica com reuniao manual nem preserva colaboradores
recon_esperado.cmd: f='src/lib/perf/reunioes/ingest.ts'; a=$(grep -c 'JANELA_DEDUPE_MS' "$f"); b=$(grep -c 'colaboradores' "$f"); [ "$a" = 0 ] && [ "$b" = 0 ] && echo SEM_DEDUPE || echo ST_${a}_${b}

criterios_aceite.descricao: tsc nao regride alem do baseline de 3 (src/ e test/, sem ruido de .next)
criterios_aceite.cmd: ( [ "$(npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep 'error TS' | grep -vc '^\.next/')" = 3 ] ) && echo OK || echo FAIL
b="$(git merge-base HEAD staging-auto)"; n=$(git diff --name-only "$b" HEAD | grep -c '[.]sql$'); [ "$n" = 0 ] && echo SEM_SQL || echo SQL_$n

criterios_aceite.descricao: so arquivos da allowlist foram tocados
criterios_aceite.cmd: b="$(git merge-base HEAD staging-auto)"; r=SO_ALLOWLIST; for f in $(git diff --name-only "$b" HEAD); do printf '%s\n' 'src/lib/perf/reunioes/ingest.ts' 'src/lib/perf/reunioes/tldv-api.ts' 'src/lib/perf/reunioes/types.ts' 'src/lib/perf/reunioes/manual.ts' 'test/reuniao-dedupe-tldv.test.ts' | grep -Fxq "$f" || r=FORA_$f; done; echo $r

criterios_aceite.descricao: diff dentro do orcamento (<= 600 linhas somando adicoes e remocoes)
criterios_aceite.cmd: b="$(git merge-base HEAD staging-auto)"; t=$(git diff --numstat "$b" HEAD | awk '{s+=$1+$2} END {print s+0}'); [ "$t" -le 600 ] && echo NO_TETO || echo ESTOUROU_$t

criterios_aceite.descricao: guardas globais seguem verdes (test/c0-guard.test.ts, test/fetch-json-teto.test.ts, test/travessao-mudo.test.ts)
criterios_aceite.cmd: npx vitest run 'test/c0-guard.test.ts' 'test/fetch-json-teto.test.ts' 'test/travessao-mudo.test.ts' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo VERDE || echo VERMELHO

criterios_aceite.descricao: ingest deduplica na janela de 2h e preserva colaboradores; cliente da API usa x-api-key sem .json() cru
criterios_aceite.cmd: f='src/lib/perf/reunioes/ingest.ts'; t='src/lib/perf/reunioes/tldv-api.ts'; test -f "$t" || { echo SEM_ARQUIVO; exit 0; }; a=$(grep -c 'JANELA_DEDUPE_MS' "$f"); b=$(grep -c 'colaboradores' "$f"); c=$(grep -c 'x-api-key' "$t"); d=$(grep -c '[.]json()' "$t"); e=$(grep -c 'TLDV_API_KEY' "$t"); [ "$a" -ge 2 ] && [ "$b" -ge 1 ] && [ "$c" -ge 1 ] && [ "$d" = 0 ] && [ "$e" -ge 1 ] && echo DEDUPE_OK || echo ST_${a}_${b}_${c}_${d}_${e}

test -f 'test/reuniao-dedupe-tldv.test.ts' && npx vitest run 'test/reuniao-dedupe-tldv.test.ts' 'test/reuniao-tldv-envelope-e-contato.test.ts' 'test/webhook-segredo-freio.test.ts' 'test/reuniao-manual-registro.test.ts' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo VERDE || echo VERMELHO
